devex-ana: FYI we hit a small but confusing parity issue in samplekit with JSON mode + fncall helpers. prompt asked for list-of-results and some models return a top-level array.
sdk-kai: what mismatch are you seeing?
devex-ana: TS helper returns raw array, Python helper's ensure_object wraps arrays into {items: [...]}. downstream schema validation expects object with id/attrs so tests fail.
sam-dev: saw this in a user onboarding session. Quick workaround was to normalize in sample app, but that's confusing for new users.
infra-maya: any config toggles?
devex-ana: samplekit defaults had "tolerate_broken_json": true. that causes helpers to coerce aggressively.
sdk-kai: we didn't intend that to be the default. suggest flipping to strict for quickstarts and adding a normalizer example.
sam-dev: opened PR to set tolerate_broken_json=false and added a doc note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/420
infra-maya: i'll add a tiny CI parity check that runs the same prompt through py/ts normalize helpers and asserts identical output.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: samplekit quickstart default config will update to v1.8.5 on merge. :white_check_mark:
devex-ana: action items: (1) merge PR 420 (sam) (2) add parity CI (maya + kai) (3) update onboarding guide to recommend strict parsing for structured outputs (sam) (4) add troubleshooting snippet showing explicit normalize function (ana).
sdk-kai: suggested snippet for docs: ```js
function normalizeToolOut(o) {
  if (Array.isArray(o)) return {items: o};
  return o;
}
```
sam-dev: will add and link PR. thanks all.
